section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section discusses the increasing prevalence of cosmetic procedures in developed countries and reviews correlates of interest in cosmetic surgery, including gender, age, attractiveness, media exposure, and body image. The authors describe the Acceptance of Cosmetic Surgery Scale (ACSS) and its subscales, then introduce 'the present study' which examines associations between the Consider subscale of the ACSS and body appreciation, media influence, weight status, and age. The section does not provide specific methodological details, sample characteristics, or empirical results.
